parsed.scene_description: A blurry indoor warehouse scene with stacks of red plastic crates on wooden pallets. A forklift is visible in the background. The ceiling has fluorescent lights and structural beams. White-wrapped goods are stacked to the right. The motion blur suggests movement during capture.

objects.label: red plastic crates
objects.observation: Stacked high on wooden pallets, primarily on left and center-right. Crates have white labels. Some are in foreground, others recede into background. Blurry due to motion. No visible supports beyond pallets.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Beneath the red crates, supporting them. Visible under crates in foreground and mid-ground. Made of wood planks. Blurry from motion. No visible supports beyond floor.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Red and black vehicle in background, centered behind crate stacks. Appears to be moving. Blurry due to motion. No visible supports or attachments beyond ground contact.

objects.label: white wrapped goods
objects.observation: Stacked on pallets to far right. Wrapped in white material, possibly shrink wrap. Blurry due to motion. No visible supports or attachments beyond pallets.

objects.label: ceiling lights and beams
objects.observation: Fluorescent lights and structural beams visible overhead. Lights are rectangular, mounted to ceiling. Beams run horizontally. Blurry due to motion. No visible supports or attachments beyond ceiling.
